correctness.rationale: For the exact 14-vertex Fano incidence graph with 21 edges, full enumeration gives 458 faces including empty and ∂3,∂4 mod-two ranks 97,44, hence global H3 dimension 6. Two separate exact GF2 chain/quotient algorithms cover all 16,384 induced subsets, verify each inclusion is injective, and agree on every histogram value. Geometry of all 21 ten-vertex supports is proved as C8 disjoint K2, and all 1,330 candidate three-class sums are checked against 28 line-complement triples. No inference beyond this finite graph, degree, or coefficient field.
